title: When someone says they didn’t use ai to make their game, I don’t believe them or care
author: uptotheright
selftext:
A.  they used aI, but only for programming

B.  they bought assets that were built with AI but they didn’t do it themselves 

C.  they built assets with AI but also did some custom work on top

D.  they are just lying and using ai

it also makes me think their game isn’t as good as it could be if they did use AI.

comments.author: YaygFX
comments.body: Spoken like someone who is only capable of making games with AI.

comments.author: Foreign-Quote-53
comments.body:
I mean honestly after working with AI so much, I do have admire how people were able to do it without.

I do think at this point it’s a bit silly for people to not use it as a tool, but I have a lot of respect for people who can develop legitimately good games without itz

comments.author: ponderdiggums
comments.body: This reads like AI elitism, and its a bit silly as we have a catalogue of wonderful games that were built well before generative AI's emergence. I would recommend a different approach if you're interested in AI being received well.

comments.author: TonyZwilde
comments.body: Or the person really didn't used AI because never tried a coding agent and still think that AI code is just ask chat GPT something and copy and paste to the project

comments.author: Aggressive_Tie_3014
comments.body:
People made video games for decades without AI.

Just because you aren't able/willing to make games without AI doesn't mean other people aren't still capable of doing so and choosing to do so.

comments.author: kilographix
comments.body: Why post this if you don't care?

comments.author: faff_rogers
comments.body: I don’t use Ai. I learned blender and make all my assets. I learned programming and do the programming myself.

comments.author: No-Marketing-9238
comments.body:
What a dumb post.  Who cares?  Especially if you wouldn't believe what someone says anyways?

Like, whats the point of your post?

replies.author: uptotheright
replies.body:
A lot of game posts lead with “I didn’t use ai to make this”.  I think it’s a mistake and focuses readers limited attention on the wrong thing.  

For as many people who would support it because they are anti AI, there are more people who absolutely don’t care and will just tune out.

comments.author: Broken-Fog-2794
comments.body: is this helping you to cope with reality?
